subject: physical-education
unitTitle: Capstone: Adult Lifetime Movement Plan and Defense
title: Concept model A: stating the reasoning behind each element
focus: stating the reasoning behind each element
essentialQuestion: What is the plan I would still be running in a year, and can I defend every part of it?
privacySafeScenario: Present the adult lifetime movement plan to one trusted adult, defend every element with reasoning and evidence from the four-year portfolio, and produce a revised final version.
studentTask: Learner applies stating the reasoning behind each element in a new situation at a self-set intensity and records what they did, noticed, and would adjust.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, explain the key idea behind stating the reasoning behind each element and name one adjustment for the next session.
completionCriteria: The learner completes or fully describes the stating the reasoning behind each element task using a version their body and setting allow.
The learner gives a cue, principle, tactic, or documented process rather than an unexplained result.
The learner self-assesses against the stated criteria and identifies one next adjustment.
adaptationChoices: The defense may be spoken one-to-one, written, presented as annotated slides, or delivered as a conversation. No public presentation, recording, or audience is required.
extensionChallenge: Apply stating the reasoning behind each element under a new constraint, in a different activity, or teach the cue to someone else — without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, drawn, demonstrated, or described responses when the standard permits.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, rest-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, or response mode.
Every movement task has a seated, supported, reduced-range, reduced-pace, and solo version that reaches the same standard.
The defense may be spoken one-to-one, written, presented as annotated slides, or delivered as a conversation. No public presentation, recording, or audience is required.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice or try one safe, optional example of stating the reasoning behind each element in daily life. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or public performance is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
